scripts.bundle: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external @fastify/static --external amqp-connection-manager --external mqtt --external kafkajs --external @nats-io/transport-node && cp deploy.package.json dist/package.json
scripts.deploy: bun run --cwd ../../../.. build:core && bun run bundle && gcloud functions deploy ailura-nestjs-hono-google-fetch --gen2 --runtime=nodejs22 --region=us-central1 --source=dist --entry-point=handler --trigger-http --no-allow-unauthenticated
scripts.dev: bun run --cwd ../../../.. build:core && bun run bundle && bunx @google-cloud/functions-framework --target=handler --port=8080
